title: Best IB Resource for a 7: Why RevisionDojo
summary: See why RevisionDojo is built for IB 45/45 goals, with 35,000+ questions, AI-marked feedback, timed mocks, and rubric-based coursework support.
body_markdown:
Students searching for the **best IB resource for a 7** need more than notes, videos, or a large collection of questions. A top-grade system must help them identify precise weaknesses, practise at the correct level, understand how marks are awarded, improve coursework against criteria, and reproduce strong performance under time pressure.


> **RevisionDojo is built for students targeting 7s and an IB 45/45 because it connects syllabus-aligned learning, 35,000+ exam-style questions, instant AI-marked feedback, timed exam practice, and criterion-level IA, EE, and TOK support in one improvement loop. It does not guarantee top marks, but it gives ambitious students the depth of practice, speed of feedback, and assessment visibility required to work systematically towards them.**


That distinction matters. Passing the IB can be achieved with uneven performance, but earning top marks requires reliable execution across subjects, assessments, and the Diploma Programme core.


### What an IB 45/45 actually requires


According to the IB's official explanation of[Diploma Programme passing criteria](https://ibo.org/about-the-ib/what-it-means-to-be-an-ib-student/recognizing-student-achievement/about-assessment/dp-passing-criteria/) , each of the six subjects receives a grade from **1 to 7** . The six subjects can therefore contribute a maximum of **42 points** , while Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay can contribute up to **3 core points** .


Diploma component Maximum contribution


Six subjects graded 1-7 42 points


TOK and Extended Essay 3 core points


Creativity, Activity, Service Required, but contributes no points


**Maximum Diploma total** **45 points**


A 45 therefore requires six subject grades of 7 and the maximum TOK and EE combination under the official core points matrix. CAS does not increase the numerical total, but it must still be completed for the Diploma to be awarded.


A subject grade of 7 is not simply a fixed percentage. Raw marks from weighted assessment components are combined and converted using the grade boundaries applicable to the subject, level, paper, examination session, and sometimes timezone. This is why a serious plan for **IB top marks** must address IAs, exam papers, command terms, timing, and core work rather than focusing on content recall alone.


### Why RevisionDojo is designed for top-grade improvement


The strongest feature of[RevisionDojo's connected IB platform](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features) is not an isolated tool. It is the ability to move through a complete cycle:


1. **Diagnose** a weakness through questions, tests, or mock examinations.
2. **Understand** the missing concept through Study Notes, lessons, or Jojo AI.
3. **Practise** the exact topic, paper, command term, or response type.
4. **Receive feedback** tied to mark-scheme or rubric expectations.
5. **Retest independently** to confirm that the weakness has been repaired.
6. **Track the effect** through later timed results and grade estimates.


Students aiming merely to finish a course can often tolerate gaps. A student targeting a 7 cannot repeatedly lose marks through incomplete working, imprecise terminology, weak evaluation, or poor timing. RevisionDojo is structured to expose those smaller losses and give the student another attempt quickly.


### Deep question practice rather than passive review


RevisionDojo's school information currently describes a bank of more than **35,000 exam-style IB questions** . The[IB Questionbank](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features/questionbank) allows students to work by subject and topic, with additional filtering available for relevant paper and course distinctions.


That depth matters because high achievement requires both **coverage** and **variation** . Solving one familiar question may demonstrate recognition, but it does not prove that the student can transfer the same idea to unfamiliar data, a different context, or a more demanding command term.


A productive top-grade practice sequence is:


- Begin with a small topic-filtered set to locate conceptual gaps.
- Attempt every question before viewing feedback or assistance.
- Record why each mark was lost, not only which answer was wrong.
- Complete new questions targeting the same weakness.
- Return to the skill several days later without notes.
- Test it again inside a mixed, timed paper.


This is substantially more useful than counting completed questions. The objective is to reduce the recurrence of specific error types.


### AI-marked feedback makes practice actionable


Practice volume alone does not produce a 7. If a student repeats an incorrect method or misunderstands what a command term requires, more practice can reinforce the wrong habit.


Jojo AI provides immediate feedback on supported responses, including written answers and diagrams. It is designed to explain what was earned, what was missing, and how the response relates to mark-scheme expectations. That shortens the interval between an attempt and a corrected attempt.


Limited practice approach Top-grade feedback approach


Check whether the final answer matches Identify where marks were earned and lost


Read the solution and move on Reattempt the question from a blank page


Record only the total score Classify conceptual, procedural, and timing errors


Practise comfortable topics Build new sets around demonstrated weaknesses


Assume understanding after review Confirm understanding on an unfamiliar question


AI marking remains **formative feedback** , not official IB grading. Students should compare important judgments with teacher guidance, especially for extended responses where valid interpretations and subject-specific conventions can require professional judgment.


### Timed mocks convert knowledge into exam performance


Many students understand a topic during untimed revision but cannot retrieve or apply it efficiently under examination conditions. A 7 requires knowledge that remains usable when questions are mixed, the clock is running, and no hints are available.


RevisionDojo's[Mock Exams and Exam Mode workflow](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-mock-exams) supports timed online simulations, while Test Builder can create targeted or broader assessments by subject, paper, topic, and question count. Online attempts can receive immediate Jojo AI feedback, and results can be reviewed by question or topic rather than as one undifferentiated total.


Predicted Papers add another form of full-paper rehearsal. They should be treated as practice papers aligned with the current syllabus, not as promises about the exact content of a future examination.


A strong mock cycle looks like this:


1. Sit the paper independently with the permitted materials and correct time limit.
2. Review every lost mark, including marks lost on questions answered correctly overall.
3. Separate errors into knowledge, application, communication, and timing categories.
4. Repair the two or three patterns with the largest mark cost.
5. Complete a fresh timed set to test whether those repairs hold.


The[IB Grade Calculator](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features/grade-calculator) can then estimate how representative component marks translate into a subject grade and Diploma total. Its output is an estimate, not a prediction guaranteed by the IB, so several timed results are more informative than one unusually strong paper.


### IA, EE, and TOK support protects marks beyond exams


An IB 45/45 cannot be built through examination revision alone. Internal assessments contribute to subject results, while the EE and TOK determine the core points added to the six subject grades.


The[RevisionDojo Coursework Grader](https://www.revisiondojo.com/grader) supports IA, EE, and TOK drafts. Students select the relevant coursework type, subject, and level where applicable, then receive annotations, a criterion-level performance breakdown, and prioritised suggestions for revision.


This is particularly useful when feedback identifies a problem precisely. “Improve the evaluation” is difficult to act on, while feedback pointing to an unsupported conclusion, an unexplained limitation, or a missing link to the research question gives the student a defined revision task.


The best workflow is iterative:


- Confirm the task, criteria, and research direction with the teacher or supervisor.
- Produce an authentic draft in the student's own words.
- Use criterion-level feedback to identify the highest-impact weaknesses.
- Revise the reasoning, evidence, method, or evaluation personally.
- Check the revised work against teacher guidance and the official criteria.
- Preserve drafts and notes that demonstrate the work's development.


The broader[RevisionDojo IA support guide](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/revisiondojo-ia-help) also connects coursework feedback with guides, exemplars, Jojo AI, subject revision, and tutors. An exemplar should be analysed for effective choices, never copied or treated as a template that guarantees a mark.


### Using Jojo AI without surrendering independent thinking


The IB does not prohibit AI tools, but its[official statement on artificial intelligence](https://ibo.org/news/news-about-the-ib/statement-from-the-ib-about-chatgpt-and-artificial-intelligence-in-assessment-and-education/) makes clear that AI-generated work is not automatically the student's own. Material produced by AI and included in assessed work must be acknowledged appropriately, and schools may impose additional rules.


For a student targeting top marks, Jojo AI is most useful as a **coach rather than an author** . Suitable uses include asking for a concept explanation, requesting one hint, identifying the first incorrect step, generating a new practice question, or clarifying rubric terminology.


It should not be used to produce submission-ready IA, EE, or TOK writing that the student presents as original work. Students should follow their school's policy, verify factual claims, maintain version history, and discuss uncertain uses with a teacher or supervisor.


Top performance depends on being able to explain and reproduce the reasoning without assistance. If AI use makes a student more dependent, it is not supporting a 7-level outcome.


### What the current survey evidence does and does not show


RevisionDojo's updated[2026 State of Learning Survey](https://www.revisiondojo.com/research/state-of-learning-survey/2026) reports findings from **364 May 2026 RevisionDojo students** . Among students with matched subject ratings, **83.4%** reported a higher average predicted subject grade, with an average increase of **0.77 points** among the relevant matched respondents.


The survey also reports that **73.3%** of the 105 students who completed both total-score check-ins increased their predicted Diploma total. Their average moved from **31.10 to 34.95** , a reported increase of **3.86 points** .


These are self-reported, observational results. They do not prove that RevisionDojo caused the changes, do not represent every user, and do not guarantee a 7 or a 45. They are best read as evidence that respondents using the platform reported meaningful progress, not as a substitute for independent performance data.


### How a 45/45 candidate can use RevisionDojo each week


A demanding target still needs a sustainable schedule. The aim is not to use every feature every day, but to assign each tool a clear function.


Weekly activity Purpose


Short daily Flashcard sessions Maintain formulas, terminology, quotations, and processes


2-3 targeted Questionbank sessions Repair narrow weaknesses and increase response variety


One timed paper or substantial section Test retrieval, pacing, and mixed-topic performance


One detailed error review Convert lost marks into specific revision tasks


Scheduled IA, EE, or TOK work Protect coursework and core progress


One retest of a previous weakness Verify improvement independently


Students should use Study Notes when understanding is weak, Flashcards when recall is unstable, Questionbank sets when application is inconsistent, and Exam Mode when timing or stamina is the problem. Jojo AI can clarify the obstacle between attempts, while a teacher or one of the available[RevisionDojo IB tutors](https://www.revisiondojo.com/tutors) can provide human judgment when a problem persists.


Parents should look for evidence of increasing independence. Useful indicators include stronger timed scores across several attempts, fewer repeated errors, clearer explanations in the student's own words, and reduced dependence on hints.


### Common mistakes when targeting IB top marks


The first mistake is treating a 7 as a content-coverage problem only. At the upper boundary, marks are often lost through application, evaluation, response structure, command-term interpretation, or time management.


The second is practising only comfortable material. High-performing students need to spend a disproportionate amount of time on the questions and criteria that expose uncertainty.


The third is reading feedback without retesting. Feedback produces improvement only when the student applies it to a new independent attempt.


The fourth is postponing IAs, TOK, or the EE while concentrating on examinations. A 45-point target leaves no part of the programme outside the plan.


Finally, students should not mistake a grade calculator, predicted paper, or AI-generated mark for an official result. These tools guide preparation; the IB's assessment process determines the final grade.


### Conclusion


RevisionDojo is built for top-grade ambitions because it combines the components that a 7-level strategy requires: extensive exam-style practice, rapid mark-scheme-aligned feedback, timed simulations, targeted content repair, and criterion-based support for IAs, the EE, and TOK. Its value lies in helping students move repeatedly from diagnosis to correction and then to independent proof.


No resource can promise an **IB 45/45** , and a serious candidate should continue using teachers, official course documents, and authentic independent work. For students who want one structured system for that process, RevisionDojo's **Questionbank, Jojo AI, Mock Exams, Coursework Grader, and Grade Calculator** are the most relevant places to begin.
